core_obligations: Introduce the site C' with the chaotic topology and the morphism of topoi given by sheafification and the inclusion (proof lines 3422-3426).
Apply the pullback statement to reduce to the chaotic case (proof lines 3427-3429).
Show that in the chaotic case the value of L_{B/A} on U is L_{B(U)/A(U)} by the commutativity of the displayed diagram (proof lines 3431-3442).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a homomorphism of sheaves of rings A -> B on a site C, the cohomology sheaf H^i(L_{B/A}) is the sheaf associated to the presheaf U -> H^i(L_{B(U)/A(U)}) (source lines 3414-3420). The proof transports the statement to the site with the chaotic topology, where presheaves are sheaves: the inclusion of sheaves into presheaves together with sheafification forms a morphism of topoi, and the pullback statement for the cotangent complex along a morphism of topoi reduces the claim to the chaotic case. There the statement follows because the diagram comparing algebras over A with the category of sheaves, and algebras over the ring of sections A(U) with sets, commutes, so the value of the complex on U is exactly the sectionwise complex.
